text:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — I'm sketching a small 'listening cohort' (8 partners) to run alongside our private preview. goal: surface deployment pain, onboarding friction, and signal for rollout gating. drafting recruitment + success criteria, want ops thoughts.

Jon Reyes: +1. do we want a mix of verticals or focus on 1-2 for depth?

Maya Chen: prefer mix but weighted to high-priority verticals (finance, healthcare). aim for 50/50 hosted vs private-capacity customers.

Priya Patel: capacity question — how many active test seats can eng-support realistically handle per week?

Evan Liu: eng-support can do live assist for 3 customers/week (deep sessions). async support ok for more.

Ana Gomez: suggest we timebox onboarding sprints: week 0 kickoff, week 1 instrumentation + smoke, weeks 2-4 feedback sprints.

Maya Chen: thinking of a two-track invite funnel: 1) reactive (existing contacts), 2) outreach (targeted ops). acceptance target ~25% -> need ~32 invites to fill 8 spots.

Priya Patel: what incentive are we offering? credits, co-marketing, priority support?

Maya Chen: combo: $5k infra credit + 3 months priority support + joint case study option (opt-in).

Jon Reyes: operational checklist idea: webhook for session transcripts -> anonymize -> S3. also consent step.

Evan Liu: add GDPR opt-in and checkbox during invite flow. store a hashed customer id, not PII.

Maya Chen: rough screening rubric (score 0-3 each):
```
- Production readiness pressure
- Data sensitivity (low/med/high)
- Integration complexity
- Willingness to run experiments (canary rollouts)
```
Total >=7 -> acceptance.

Ana Gomez: love the rubric. can we add a behavioral criterion:"willing to join 3 feedback sessions"?

Maya Chen: yes add as binary pass/fail.

eng-bot: reminder: please file a tracking sheet in the product drive (template: /templates/dp-cohort-tracker)

Priya Patel: who owns the tracker & handoffs to CS?

Maya Chen: Product to own tracking + initial invites. CS to own onboarding calls and SLA for ongoing issues. assign: Maya (product), Priya (CS lead), Evan (eng escalation).

Jon Reyes: feedback cadence proposal: weekly quick-sync (30m) + biweekly deep review (60m) + an async digest every Friday. raw logs + highlight tickets attached.

Ana Gomez: add a 'listening sprint' artifact: a 1-page pain memo per partner after week 2 that collects top 3 blockers + suggested mitigations.

Maya Chen: success criteria suggestions (must meet 2 of 3):
- onboarding time < 5 days from kickoff to smoke pass
- critical blocker count <=1 after week 4
- customer-reported NPS >= 7 at week 4
- measurable latency/cost improvement vs baseline for at least 1 workflow (10%+)
Note: need at least 2 of the above to consider cohort a win.

Priya Patel: can we instrument auto-metrics for onboarding time? CS can mark stages in tracker; engineering will emit smoke_pass event.

Evan Liu: will add a metric: `dp.smoke_pass` event to our telemetry. also add `dp.feedback_submitted`.

Jon Reyes: rollback/escape hatch: if partner hits P0 blocker, we pause experiments and open a hotfix channel; agree to a 48-hour target to respond.

Ana Gomez: delivery timeline? publish invites next Tue, screen Wed-Thu, notify Fri, kickoff the following Mon. tight but doable.

Maya Chen: proposed owner list + next steps:
- Maya: finalize invite copy + tracker (due Mon)
- Priya: confirm incentive legal + CS scheduling window (due Mon)
- Evan: telemetry instrument & hotfix playbook (due Fri)
- Jon: outreach list (10 targets) + intro emails (due Tue)
- Ana: feedback templates & 1-page memo template (due Fri)

Priya Patel: noted. legal flagged the case study opt-in language — will update copy and ping Maya.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled message -> reminder: create calendar invites for kickoff sessions after acceptance.

Maya Chen: thanks all. short ask: if you can react in this thread with :thumbsup: when you ack your action items, i'll lock the plan and start outreach.

Evan Liu: :thumbsup:

Jon Reyes: :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: :thumbsup:

Ana Gomez: :thumbsup:
